text:
alice: Quick preflight — planning to push v2026.3 to prod today 17:30 UTC. Can owners ack and confirm rollback readiness? :eyes:
ben: Ack for infra — my team will be on standby. What’s the canary ratio?
alice: Starting at 5% for first 10m, then 25% for 15m if no errors, then full.
carla: Confirming smoke checklist: 1) no new DB migrations, 2) feature flag toggles prepared, 3) dashboards ready. All good from product.
devon: No DB migrations. Feature flag "new-routing" ready and tested in staging. I'll hold the toggle during canary.
emma: I'll run the smoke commands and monitor logs during the 5% window. Posting quick runbook below:

emma: SMOKE STEPS:
1) curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.ai/health || echo "health fail"
2) kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=api -o wide
3) kubectl -n inference logs deployment/api --tail=150 | tail -n 80
4) check console > Routes > latency 95th < 300ms

ben: infra-bot will do instance readiness checks and resume autoscaling if needed.
infra-bot: [deploy-check] Running node health checks: all nodes green, GPU utilization baseline OK, SSD pressure < 30%.
carla: Security note: KMS rotation not scheduled during deploy window. No secrets changes. OK to proceed.
devon: Rollback plan: tagged image v2026.2 kept as fallback, canary immediately rolled back by setting image to v2026.2 and flipping flag off. I have the rollback command ready:

devon: kubectl -n inference set image deployment/api api=registry.redwood/v2026.2 && kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/api

emma: I’ll run smoke steps at 17:35 UTC and post results here. If any 5xx or latency spikes > 500ms, we pause and escalate.
ben: I'll monitor infra metrics, set alerts for CPU/GPU spikes and API 5xx rate.
sre-oncall: I'm on standby for escalation. log collection playbook available if we need postmortem.
alice: Great — final asks: everyone react with :white_check_mark: to this thread when you’re in-sync. I’ll kick at 17:30 UTC if all checks pass.
carla: :white_check_mark:
devon: :white_check_mark:
emma: :white_check_mark: (will post smoke output)
ben: :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: [note] Canary window scheduled: start 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z, initial 5% for 10m.
